create_ssteval_binary: create an SSTEval instance for binary sentiment classification with default seed
create_ssteval_finegrained: create an SSTEval instance for 5-class fine-grained sentiment classification
run_ssteval: run SSTEval with params and batcher to compute embeddings and evaluate classification accuracy
load_ssteval_file: load SST sentiment data from a file path for binary or fine-grained classification
prepare_ssteval_samples: prepare SSTEval samples using a prepare function with params and all train/dev/test sentences
